notes: The media controls are drawn icons now, as one set. They were plain keyboard characters, and Windows renders several of those from its colour emoji font - so the row was a mix of styles, weights and colours sitting in a panel drawn…

All five are now drawn to the same grid at the same line weight, in the panel accent colour, and they take the colour of whatever they sit in - so hovering or dimming a button carries its icon with it.
They live in a shared file, so any panel that shows a media card gets the same five rather than its own near-copies.
